title: Work Unit (Prompt Two, 19 mandatory fields) - STRUCTURAL profile
description: The per-unit record contract. Spec anchor: _USER-PROMPTS.md:10605-10625 ('Every work unit must have: stable ID; title; phase; exact question or implementation target; inputs; dependencies; assigned model/vendor/role; tool permissions; execution substrate; timeout; output path; output schema; evidence requirement; tests required; reviewer requirement; completion sentinel; retry policy; failure classification; and owner-approval requirement, if any.'). ALL 19 are REQUIRED PER UNIT: a catalog-level `defaults` block is an optional authoring convenience and is NEVER the only way to express a field - see work-unit-catalog.schema.json#/properties/defaults and platform/lib/wfdsl/resolve.py. This STRUCTURAL profile encodes the field set, JSON types and the union shapes actually present in the 2,007-unit catalog measured 2026-08-09; work-unit.normative.schema.json adds value domains and work-unit.strict.schema.json adds canonical single-form requirements.

phase.$comment: spec field 3: phase. String (not integer) because the program uses letter-suffixed sub-phases 2A/2B/2C/7A.

question_or_target.$comment: spec field 4: exact question or implementation target

inputs.$comment: spec field 5: inputs. At least one - a unit with no declared input cannot be audited for provenance.

dependencies.$comment: spec field 6: dependencies. MAY be empty (a root unit); tokens are unit ids or bucket ids - see the normative profile.

assigned_model_vendor_role.$comment: spec field 7: assigned model/vendor/role. Two shapes exist in the corpus: the object form (1,879 units) and a 'model/vendor/role' slash-triple string (128 units). Both are accepted here; the strict profile requires the object form.

tool_permissions.$comment: spec field 8: tool permissions. At least one - an empty list is indistinguishable from 'unspecified'.

timeout_seconds.$comment: spec field 10: timeout. Integer seconds; a boolean must not slip through (JSON booleans are not integers here).

output_schema.$comment: spec field 12: output schema. A reference to a schema document, not the schema body.

tests_required.$comment: spec field 14: tests required. Array form (1,911 units) or a single prose string (96 units); the strict profile requires the array.

completion_sentinel.$comment: spec field 16: completion sentinel. Cross-field rule SEM-002 (validator, not schema) requires it to name the unit's own id.

failure_classification.$comment: spec field 18: failure classification. Array of class tokens (1,911 units) or a single prose string (96 units); the strict profile requires the array.

owner_approval_required.$comment: spec field 19: owner-approval requirement. Boolean, never absent: an absent field would read as 'probably fine' (adverse-inference).

_source_slice_file.$comment: documented non-spec extra: which catalog slice this unit was merged from

$comment: There is deliberately NO `additionalProperties` keyword here. Omitting it and setting it to `true` are identical for VALIDATION (both allow unknown properties) but NOT for ANNOTATION: `additionalProperties: true` marks every unknown property as EVALUATED, which silently disables `unevaluatedProperties: false` in the strict profile that composes over this one. Measured on this box before the fix: a unit carrying a bogus `typo_field` passed the strict profile. Omitting the keyword keeps this profile permissive while leaving the strict profile's typo check live.

assignment_triple_string.$comment: '<model>/<vendor>/<role>' - exactly two slashes, no empty segment
